-- VIEWER ONLY: client camera follows the real prepared R07 NPC.
-- No World/Native call, body write, action, path, remote or simulated movement.
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
assert(RunService:IsClient(),"R07_VIEWER_CLIENT_ONLY")
local KEY="DEE_R07_PASSIVE_NPC_VIEWER_R01"
assert(_G[KEY]==nil,"R07_VIEWER_ALREADY_INSTALLED")
local OFFSET=Vector3.new(35,28,30)
local MAX_SECONDS=21600
local installed=os.clock()
local state={installed=true,active=false,frames=0,waitingFrames=0,
    world="workspace.RBX01",body="DEE_Body",root="HumanoidRootPart",
    offset={35,28,30},fieldOfView=55,Native_calls=0,World_calls=0,
    body_writes=0,uses_LocalPlayer_character=false}
local originalCamera=nil
local original=nil
local stopped=false
local function stop()
    if stopped then return end
    stopped=true
    RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(KEY)
    local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
    if camera and camera==originalCamera and original then
        camera.CameraType=original.kind
        camera.CameraSubject=original.subject
        camera.CFrame=original.frame
        camera.Focus=original.focus
        camera.FieldOfView=original.fov
    end
    state.active=false;state.stopped=true
end
state.stop=stop
_G[KEY]=state
RunService:BindToRenderStep(KEY,Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value,function()
    if os.clock()-installed>MAX_SECONDS then stop();return end
    local world=workspace:FindFirstChild("RBX01")
    local body=world and world:FindFirstChild("DEE_Body")
    local root=body and body:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid=body and body:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not(body and body:IsA("Model") and root and root:IsA("BasePart")
        and root.Parent==body and root:GetAttribute("R07PreparedBody")==true
        and humanoid and humanoid.Parent==body and camera)then
        state.active=false;state.waitingFrames+=1;return
    end
    if not originalCamera then
        originalCamera=camera
        original={kind=camera.CameraType,subject=camera.CameraSubject,
            frame=camera.CFrame,focus=camera.Focus,fov=camera.FieldOfView}
    end
    local focus=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1.5,0)
    camera.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    camera.FieldOfView=55
    camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(focus+OFFSET,focus)
    camera.Focus=CFrame.new(focus)
    state.active=true;state.frames+=1
    state.lastObservedRootPosition={root.Position.X,root.Position.Y,root.Position.Z}
end)
return {installed=true,waiting_for_actual_R07_NPC=true,
    binding=KEY,world=state.world,body=state.body,root=state.root,
    offset=state.offset,fieldOfView=state.fieldOfView,maxSeconds=MAX_SECONDS,
    Native_calls=0,World_calls=0,body_writes=0,camera_only=true}
